question: Pandit Bhimsen Joshi, the Hindustani classical vocalist, is a follower of which gharana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Pandit Bhimsen Joshi**

__
 
• Born on 4 February 1922 in Gadak district of Karnataka.
 
• He was fond of music since childhood.
 
• He was greatly influenced by** Abdul Karim Khan**, the founder of **Kirana Gharana.**
 
• In 1933 he left home in search of Guru. He stayed in Bijapur, Pune and Gwalior for the next two years.
 
• He also took music lessons from Ustad Hafiz Ali Khan of Gwalior.
 
• He received his early education in classical music from Pandit Rambhau Kundgolkar, a disciple of Abdul Karim Khan.
 
• He visited Calcutta and Punjab before returning home.
 
• By 1937, Pandit Bhimsen Joshi had become a well-known khyal singer. There he also learned the nuances of khayal singing from Sawai Gandharva for many years.
 
• Besides singing, he has also mastered thumri and bhajan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Bhendi bazaar Gharana** was founded around 1890 by brothers Chhajju Khan, Nazir Khan, and Khadim Hussain Khan in the Bhendi bazaar area of Mumbai.
 
• **Agra Gharana** represents a unique tradition of Hindustani Classical Music. Its compositions are known to be remarkable for their lyrical beauty and also for their musical potential.
 
• The bandishes of the Ragas are deeply influenced by the Braj culture, i.e. Lord Krishna and his enchanting levels, making it the most fascinating part of the Agra Gharana Gayaki.
 
• **Patiala Gharana** is one of the Gharanas in Indian Classical Music, which was founded by Ustad Fateh Ali Khan, and also Ustad Ali Baksh.
 
• Patiala Gharana has both kinds of singing – **‘Thumri’ and ‘Khyal’.**
 
• The most famous exponents of Patiala Gharana are Pakistani ghazal singer Gulam Ali, and also the contemporary singer Shafqat Amanat Ali.
